summary: Implemented the feature in the repository (uncommitted). Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and appended the str-valued EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with eleven members, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept an absent endpoint config (no variant tags); added public ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults(region_name, service_name, s3_config, endpoint_bridge, client_endpoint_url, legacy_endpoint_url) returning a mapping keyed by all eleven members, with SDK_ENDPOINT None when absent. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.model and added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (unittest.TestCase) with one test per behavioral criterion. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_regions.py and test_client.py pass (414 tests) under the shared venv. Added lines are within 79 columns by manual check; black was not available in the venv, so black formatting was not verified. Choices: SDK_ENDPOINT key is always present (None when absent); FIPS and DualStack read through the bridge's private lookup methods; the addressing-style tests were collapsed to one auto-case test to avoid duplicate bodies.
